input.title: 2023 Hobie Mirage Pro Angler 14 360
input.descriptionHtml:
Experience Elite Kayak Fishing with this Used Hobie Mirage Pro Angler 14 360 - Featuring a Brand-New Hull!
 
Financing Available!

Get the best of both worlds with this used Hobie Mirage Pro Angler 14 360 kayak, boasting all the features elite anglers are looking for in a fishing kayak. This kayak comes with a brand-new hull, which was recently replaced under warranty in 2023 and has never been in the water. The hull carries the balance of its warranty expiring on 1/31/2024. All other parts are from 2020 and are used. Financing options are available starting at $234.47 per month with $0 down and all taxes and fees included*.

The Mirage Pro Angler 14 360 offers total control, power, stability, performance, stealth, comfort, and feature-rich capabilities. Its wide, rock-solid standing platform is decked out with noise-reducing EVA traction pads. With the MirageDrive 360 propulsion system, you can move in any direction, making it perfect for exploring and sight fishing. The kayak also features Kick-Up fins that automatically retract upon impact, six horizontal rod holders, tackle compartments, an elevated Vantage ST seat, and acres of H-Rail for mounting accessories.

Length: 13' 8" / 4.17 m
Width: 38" / .97 m
Hull Weight: 124.5 LBS / 56.5 KG
Fully Rigged Weight: 148.5 LBS / 67.4 KG
Capacity: 600 lbs / 272 kg
Vantage Seat Capacity: 350 lbs / 159 kg
Crew: 1


*Must be approved by Synchrony Financial with a large enough credit line to cover the purchase price. Listed price assumes 24-month financing and equal payments across those months, your minimum payment may be different. Call (815) 433-2200 for more info or click here to apply
